title.rendered: Xech- Hue II Digital Alarm Clock with Speaker

content.rendered:
DIGITAL ALARM CLOCK WITH SPEAKER WITH AMBIENT RGB LIGHT AND MORE!

Step into a world of elegance and utility with XECH Hue – Ambient Digital Clock Speaker. This refined timepiece, now elevated on its purposeful stand, seamlessly integrates a digital LED clock, ambient night light, and wireless speaker. Immerse yourself in the glow of 6 colour ambient lights, and 6 dynamic RGB lighting, all while keeping your essentials organized with a dual-slot pen holder and smartphone groove. With 5 different alarm sounds, FM radio, and a rechargeable battery, “Hue” not only tells time but orchestrates an immersive experience in your space.

FEATURES

  • Digital Alarm Clock
  • Dynamic RGB Lighting
  • Ambient Night Light
  • Wireless Speaker
  • Emergency Battery
  • Radio FM
  • Dual Slot Pen Holder
  • Smart Phone Holder

FUNCTIONS

  • Alarm Clock
  • 5 Alarm Sounds
  • Snooze
  • 6 Ambient Lights
  • 6 Dynamic Lights
  • Wireless Speaker
  • Radio FM
  • Pen Stand
  • Smartphone Holder

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Wattage: 5W
  • Voltage: 5V
  • Input Type: USB-C
  • Impedance: 4Ω
  • Driver: 40mm
  • Wireless Version: 5.3v
  • Transmission Range: 10m
  • Frequency: 87.5 – 108MHz
  • Clock Display: LED
  • Product Dimensions: 115mm x 110mm x 110mm

 

  • MOQ- 50 Pcs.
  • Printing, GST & Delivery charges will be charged extra.
  • Printing Option – Digital UV Printing, Screen Printing
